xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: OpenClaw parent text-repetition hang after thin subagent DONE

plan.title: bug(openclaw): parent agent text-repetition hang after thin subagent completion

narratives.Description: OpenClaw parent agents can enter a text-only repetition hang after thin subagent completion events, regenerating the same progress sentence with zero tool calls. This story documents the failure mode and hardens parent-monitor policy and product guidance so completion events force tool-first or yield behavior.
narratives.Overview: OpenClaw Control UI parent hang; separate from empty-leaf death but triggered by thin DONE.
narratives.UserStory: As an OpenClaw swarm parent, I want thin leaf completions to force a tool batch or yield instead of narrated progress prose, so that the parent cannot lock into a zero-tool repetition hang.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit content/docs/openclaw-agent-host.md module section for parent-monitor after subagent_announce: tool-first batch (gh/git files) or sessions_yield; forbid multi-sentence progress-only prose. Step 2: Edit content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md and content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md scripts for thin DONE failure (no prUrl/merge) and completion-event contract fields. Step 3: Add content-contract test markers under packages/core/src/content-contracts for those file strings. Step 4: CHANGELOG Unreleased cites #2943. Verification: run unit tests on content-contracts package and task check:merge before push.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance maps to #2943; missing_traces_justification until lines mapped.

items.title: Parent monitor policy tool-first after leaf announce

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs/skills for OpenClaw swarm parents, when a subagent completion arrives, then guidance requires tool-first ground truth or yield and forbids multi-sentence progress-only first response.

items.title: Thin DONE treated as failed leaf

narrative.Acceptance: Given a leaf completion without PR URL or merge evidence, when parent policy is followed, then the leaf is treated as failed (re-dispatch or take over) not as success.
Given the PR, when tests and CHANGELOG are inspected, then content-contract markers pass and Unreleased cites #2943.
